meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 按步骤把 DeltaChat 渠道接入你的项目:复制适配器与它的注册测试、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server、构建并跑测试,再从 .env 读取邮箱凭据。之后机器人通过加密邮件收发消息和文件附件。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目接入 DeltaChat 渠道、配置它的邮箱凭据,或排查收不到消息等问题时接管。

say.text: 帮我把 DeltaChat 渠道加到项目里
say.note: 会抓取适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试

say.text: 把 .env 里的 DeltaChat 邮箱凭据配好
say.note: 写入六个必需变量并重启服务

say.text: DeltaChat 收不到消息,帮我查一下日志
say.note: 检查适配器是否启动、连通性与接线

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to your project: copies the adapter and its registration test, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, builds and validates, then reads email credentials from .env so the bot exchanges encrypted messages and files.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add the DeltaChat channel to a project, set up its email credentials, or debug messages not arriving.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to this project.
say_en.note: Fetches the adapter, installs deps, builds, runs the registration test.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat email credentials in .env.
say_en.note: Writes the six required variables and restarts the service.

say_en.text: DeltaChat messages aren't arriving - check the logs.
say_en.note: Checks adapter startup, connectivity and wiring.
